notes.title: HELLENIC GAME AWARDS 2025 – Victory for Neoblazer: Corpo Run!
notes.notes: [p]*Post below in English and Modern Greek.[/p][p]HELLENIC GAME AWARDS 2025 – Victory for Neoblazer: Corpo Run![/p][p]ーーーーーーー[/p][p]We are proud to announce that Neoblazer: Corpo Run has won the Game of the Year – Audience Choice award at the Hellenic Game Awards, breaking records with more than 250 votes out of roughly 350 in total.[/p][p]This recognition is particularly meaningful, as it comes directly from the players themselves. The overwhelming support from fans and the community highlights the passion and momentum that Neoblazer has built.[/p][p]Our team sincerely thanks everyone who supported the game, cast their votes, and shared the vision behind Neoblazer.[/p][p]This milestone is only the beginning. The journey of Neoblazer continues with even greater momentum. 🚀[/p][p]ーーーーーーー[/p][p]ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΑ ΒΡΑΒΕΙΑ ΒΙΝΤΕΟΠΑΙΧΝΙΔΙΩΝ 2025 – Νίκη για το Neoblazer: Corpo Run![/p][p]ーーーーーーー[/p][p]Με υπερηφάνεια σας ανακοινώνουμε ότι το παιχνίδι Neoblazer: Corpo Run κατέκτησε το βραβείο Game of the Year – Audience Choice. στα Hellenic Game Awards, σημειώνοντας ρεκόρ με περισσότερες από 250 ψήφους σε σύνολο περίπου 350.[/p][p]Η διάκριση αυτή είναι ιδιαίτερα σημαντική, καθώς προέρχεται αποκλειστικά από την ψήφο του κοινού. Το γεγονός ότι τόσοι παίκτες και υποστηρικτές στάθηκαν δίπλα στο Neoblazer δείχνει τη δυναμική και το πάθος που έχει δημιουργήσει η κοινότητά του.[/p][p]Η ομάδα μας ευχαριστεί θερμά όλους όσους στήριξαν το παιχνίδι, συμμετείχαν στην ψηφοφορία και μοιράστηκαν το όραμα πίσω από το Neoblazer.[/p][p]Αυτή η νίκη είναι μόνο η αρχή. Το ταξίδι του Neoblazer συνεχίζεται με ακόμη μεγαλύτερη ώθηση. 🚀[/p][p]ーーーーーーー[/p][p]#Neoblazer #HellenicGameAwards #AudienceChoice #GameoftheYear #Warägergarde #IndieDev #Gameathlon[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/c1a62d773bb9b848cf266171e98d962df46186fc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/1134daa1a5f9e20e65a5a308255496e704df4f00.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/f9b938c4cc6d64ace405c96d9c1746fce7e946fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/e1c19cfd365d591305755a4cd6ccfa18ca1987b6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/8da4cd5879e38f42396a5c563f516f331c208d56.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/c64b6b955d043c09e77dba30e8787b84d445c8d2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43736053/a36fe4e396eeb924d7e770394db8140d320b5fe2.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Captain Dodger x Neoblazer FREE UPDATE
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="yrE5HbYyJps;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We're happy to announce a new [b]Captain Dodger X Neoblazer[/b] collaboration. You'll find a new character [i]Drax Gorbuloid [/i]inside the Porkotyler map.[/p][p][/p][p]In a universe ruled by ruthless megacorporations, Drax Gorbuloid is just a sewer worker with no future—until one bad decision lands him in the middle of an underground rebellion. Labeled a "Neoblazer," Drax must choose between the safety of submission and the chaos of freedom. Darkly funny and sharply relevant, Neoblazer is a sci-fi satire about corporate dystopia, lost humanity, and the spark that starts a revolution.[/p]

notes.title: Fortnite: Sea Of Corruption - Gameplay Trailer | UEFN |
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=v_ZRfsjT_ro;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore the Sea of Corruption! A new series of Fortnite adventures. This deadly reality focuses on a deal gone wrong between ambitious pirates, and an ancient god of the deep. Sea of Corruption was developed by Lead Game Designer Pantelis Kassotis and is inspired by the Captain Dodger game series.

About this island - 2911-2665-8719

Welcome to the Tōkotsu Island of the Girisha archipelago. Tōkotsu is the capital of a large pirate territory under attack. Mercenaries from all across the world are fighting for control of this island and it’s up to you to end the conflict. In this Team Deathmatch you will find plenty of wealth and adventure. Be warned however. Tōkotsu can be very treacherous and the thick fog of this island can reveal not only treasures but also dangers beyond count.

[url=https://www.fortnite.com/@tethorax] You can find Sea of Corruption on Fortnite's official website. [/url]

notes.title: Nominate Us!
notes.notes:
Do you love defeating pirates? Is defending the docks challenging enough for you?

We are excited to announce that Captain Dodger has been nominated for Best Game You Suck At at the 2023 Steam Awards!

Now we need your help! Voting is now live for the Steam 2023 Awards and we need you to go vote for your favorite game! Don’t miss your chance to let your voice be heard and go vote for Captain Dodger! Deadline ends Nov 28th @ 10AM Pacific.

notes.title: Captain Dodger: Drowned Realm FREE UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i]Welcome to the Drowned Realm! Here you will find a new adventure but also some old enemies waiting for you. Assume the form of a merman and vanquish those evil spirits![/i]

[b]Added game features include:[/b]

• New levels
• New characters
• Improved graphics
• Full controller support
• Steam achievements

We'd like to thank you for your continued support. We took all your comments seriously and worked hard to fix the game's issues. It is our belief that if you liked the game before, you're going to love it now. Stay tuned because we'll be adding even more stuff as time progresses. We think Captain Dodger is more than a simple roguelike. It has a real story to tell and we intent to keep exploring it wherever it leads.

notes.title: Captain Dodger - Mobile Edition - A Long Awaited Port
notes.notes:
You spoke and we listened. We are officially announcing Captain Dodger - Mobile Edition. This beautiful gem of a game is finally available for android devices, and it offers a serious upgrade to the original PC experience. Everything is smooth and optimised for your pleasure and specifically designed to keep you hooked for hours on end.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobile.captaindodger

notes.title: Captain Dodger animation project approved at Kassotis+
notes.notes: Kassotis+ wishes to release a Captain Dodger cartoon in the future. The Athenian studio plans to explore the lore of the franchise and turn it into more games and possibly comic books. We’ll see. The certain thing is that fans of the roguelike game will get more content and that’s great news. Stay tuned for more game updates!

notes.title: Captain Dodger gets its own attraction at Porkoland
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Captain Dodger is getting his own attraction at a movie studio theme park! Captain Dodger will have a permanent spot at Porkoland which is the virtual reality theme park of Kassotis Productions, the movie studio that owns TETHORAX SOFTWORKS.

This means more games and other forms of media for our little pirate in the near future. Stay tuned! To learn more about this you can visit the Kassotis+ website. It's free!
